prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lumiverse chat UI redesign mockup, Connections V5 revised, variant A
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity dark Lumiverse chat screenshot-style UI mockup based on the provided current chat screenshot layout: one large chat message card above, composer at bottom, and an expanded horizontal connection profile carousel above the composer. Apply these changes: model/provider thumbnails are much smaller than before; include a visible thumbnail/icon size slider labeled compact to large; add tag chips near Favorites and Recent so the user can filter by profile tags; the user can add tags to each connection profile; clicking a connection thumbnail opens tag/filter controls; add a small connection-menu icon next to the other toolbar icons above the input box; remove the large connection profile button next to the microphone/input area. Keep the actual message content area visually unchanged. Show Favorites, Recent, and tag filters in a compact header with minimal wasted text. Dark glass UI, blue accents, compact cards, precise resize handles for making the carousel smaller or larger.
Text to include: "Favorites", "Recent", "+ Tag", "RP", "Claude", "Local", "Icon size", "Compact", "Large", "Lord Router", "Claude Opus 4.6", "Search".
Constraints: Preserve Lumiverse dark theme and chat/composer layout. Avoid red annotation marks. No green millisecond badges. No giant thumbnails. No connection profile pill beside the microphone.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lumiverse chat UI redesign mockup, Connections V5 revised, variant B
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity dark Lumiverse chat screenshot-style UI mockup based on the current chat screenshot layout: chat card, bottom composer, and a connection switcher opened from a new small icon in the composer toolbar. Apply these changes: the opened connection menu is compact and user-resizable; provider thumbnails/cards can be scaled with an icon size control; the menu has tabs for Favorites, Recent, and user-created tags; each connection card shows small provider icon, profile name, model name, favorite star, and tag chips. Remove the old connection profile button next to microphone/input; replace it with a tiny toolbar icon among the other top-row composer icons. Make the menu feel like a fast switcher, not a huge gallery.
Text to include: "Connections", "Favorites", "Recent", "Tags", "Add tag", "Compact cards", "Icon 32px", "Row height", "Lord Router", "WATARU GPT 5.4", "nvidia nim".
Constraints: Dark Lumiverse visual language, no red markup, no green latency/ms badges, thumbnails intentionally small with visible user controls to make them smaller/larger.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lumiverse lore indicator V4 revised mockup, variant A
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity dark Lumiverse chat screenshot-style UI based on the provided lore indicator V4 screenshot. Show the chat card above, composer below, and a lore status panel above the composer. Apply these changes: every bottom-strip indicator is individually toggleable/removable by the user; include a small customization popover showing checkboxes for Active entries, Tokens, Passes, Constant, Keyword, Vector, Book names, Search, and Group by. The bottom strip should only show enabled items and should be able to completely remove any indicator. Show the full expanded lore panel with grouped lorebooks and entries, but make it clear the bottom indicator bar is configurable.
Text to include: "Lore status", "96 active", "59.5k tokens", "2 passes", "Customize indicators", "Show", "Hide", "Constant", "Keyword", "Vector", "Book names", "Reset".
Constraints: Use the actual Lumiverse dark/glass style. No red annotation text. Preserve the V4 broad bottom-panel concept. Make customization obvious.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lumiverse lore indicator V4 revised mockup, variant B
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity dark Lumiverse chat screenshot-style UI based on the lore indicator V4 concept. Show a compact bottom lore strip embedded above the input composer, plus an opened settings drawer/palette for choosing exactly which lore indicators appear. The user can reorder indicators by dragging, hide any indicator, and choose compact icon-only or icon+text mode. The expanded lore panel should show active entries grouped by lorebook, with Constant/Keyword/Vector colored icons and edit buttons. Bottom bar should be cleaner than the original, with only selected chips visible.
Text to include: "Lore strip settings", "Drag to reorder", "Icon only", "Remove", "Active", "Tokens", "Passes", "Constant", "Keyword", "Vector", "Apply".
Constraints: Dark Lumiverse UI, no red marks, no crowded bottom bar; demonstrate user control over every bottom item.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lumiverse Character Browser V3 plus V5 combined mockup, variant A
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity dark Lumiverse Characters screen screenshot-style UI based on the provided Character Browser V3 and V5 screenshots. Combine V3's character-card visual design with V5's uniform standardized thumbnail sizing and right-side detail model. Remove the date from character cards. Use the previously wasted footer space for tags and compact metadata. Keep search, tag filter, sort dropdown, density slider, and customize view controls. The card grid should look uniform and dense, with consistent thumbnail aspect ratio, no visible date text, and tag chips directly under names. Include a right detail panel for the selected character with image, name, tags, lorebooks, last chat, and actions.
Text to include: "Characters", "Search characters, tags, creators...", "All Tags", "Sort", "Density", "Customize view", "Vexis", "Demon", "Villain", "Open in chat", "Edit character".
Constraints: Dark Lumiverse style; no red annotation marks; no dates on cards; combine V3 card aesthetics with V5 uniform thumbnails and detail panel.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lumiverse Character Browser V3 plus V5 combined mockup, variant B
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity dark Lumiverse Characters screen screenshot-style UI. It must combine the V3 card gallery design with the V5 uniform image thumbnails and the V5 right-side character detail modal/panel. The grid should be denser and cleaner: consistent card widths, standardized image ratio, no dates, tags shown in the formerly wasted bottom area, optional compact footer toggle. The right-side panel should be docked and resizable, showing selected character image, name, tags, lorebooks, last chat, Open in chat, Edit character. Add a customize popover that controls thumbnail width, thumbnail height, footer metadata, tag rows, and panel width.
Text to include: "Customize view", "Thumbnail width", "Thumbnail height", "Footer tags", "Panel width", "No dates", "Compact footer", "Vexis", "Tags", "Lorebooks".
Constraints: Dark UI, realistic app mockup, no red annotation text, maintain Lumiverse sidebar and toolbar feel.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lumiverse World Book Editor V1/V2 revised mockup, variant A
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity dark Lumiverse World Book Editor screenshot-style UI based on the provided World Book Editor screenshot. Keep the three-pane layout: books column, entries column, editor pane. Add independent resizable splitters between Books, Entries, and Editing Entry panes, with visible drag handles. Add bulk entry selection controls: select all entries, multi-select checkboxes, bulk edit toolbar for Priority, Depth, Position, and Activation Type. Entries must show more metadata directly in the list: priority, depth, position, type badge (Constant/Keyword/Vector/Semantic), token count, and enabled state. Include bulk conversion controls to change selected entries between Constant, Vector/Semantic, or Keyword.
Text to include: "World Book Editor", "Books", "Entries", "Editing Entry", "Select all", "12 selected", "Bulk edit", "Priority", "Depth", "Position", "Activation type", "Constant", "Keyword", "Vector", "Apply to selected", "Resizable panes".
Constraints: Preserve dark Lumiverse editor feel, no red annotations, make pane resizing independent, show entry metadata clearly.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lumiverse World Book Editor V1/V2 revised mockup, variant B
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity dark Lumiverse World Book Editor screenshot-style UI showing an inspector-style version that could open from the lore book indicator or a dedicated icon instead of full modal. Include a compact side editor with entries list and selected entry editor. Add bulk entry actions: select all visible, filter selected, set priority/depth/position, change selected to Constant, Keyword, or Vector/Semantic, enable/disable selected, duplicate selected. Entry rows must show priority, depth, position, activation type, token count, and status. Panes have draggable dividers so the user can make books, entries, or editor sections smaller or bigger independently.
Text to include: "Lorebook inspector", "Open full editor", "Select all", "Bulk actions", "Priority 80", "Depth 2", "Before Main", "Set type", "Constant", "Keyword", "Vector", "Apply", "Drag divider".
Constraints: Dark Lumiverse chat/editor style; no red annotations; focus on bulk editing and independently resizable panes.
